sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER TROUGH SITUATED OVER THE DAKOTAS WILL ADVANCE SLOWLY EWD INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY AND GREAT LAKES REGION CONTRIBUTING TO THE SWD ADVANCE OF A COLD FRONT THROUGH THE TX PANHANDLE AND INTO OK TODAY. DRYLINE WILL MIX EWD THROUGH WEST TX SOUTH OF A LEE LOW. A TROPICAL SYSTEM OVER THE SERN GULF OF MEXICO SHOULD REACH THE NERN GULF LATE IN THIS PERIOD.

sections.title: WRN AND NRN TX THROUGH OK
sections.text: ELY UPSLOPE REGIME WILL BECOME ESTABLISHED ONCE AGAIN IN GRADIENT ZONE BETWEEN LEE-LOW AND CP HIGH PRESSURE MOVING SWD THROUGH THE CNTRL PLAINS...WHILE COLD FRONT ADVANCES THROUGH THE TX PANHANDLE AND SRN KS/NRN OK DURING THE DAY. TRAILING PORTIONS OF OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WILL SETTLE SWD THROUGH INTO NRN/NWRN TX. THE ATMOSPHERE IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE WHERE DIABATIC WARMING OCCURS IN MOIST UPSLOPE REGIME FROM ERN NM THROUGH WRN TX NORTH OF LEE LOW AS WELL AS IN VICINITY OF THE E-W CONVECTIVELY REINFORCED BOUNDARY ACROSS NWRN TX. THERE IS SOME CONCERN THAT RECOVERY ACROSS OK IN WAKE OF THE MORNING CONVECTION AND NORTH OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY COULD BE SLOW DUE TO POTENTIAL FOR LINGERING CLOUDS AND PRECIPITATION. STORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP WITHIN UPSLOPE REGIME OVER ERN NM AND SPREAD EWD INTO WRN TX. OTHER STORMS MAY DEVELOP ALONG THE DRYLINE AND EWD ALONG THE E-W CONVECTIVELY REINFORCED BOUNDARY ACROSS NRN TX. SUPERCELLS WILL LIKELY BE THE INITIAL STORM MODE ACROSS ERN NM INTO WRN TX WITH A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL. THESE STORMS MAY EVENTUALLY CONGEAL INTO AN MCS DURING THE EVENING WITH AN INCREASING THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND. IF THE ATMOSPHERE CAN RECOVER ACROSS OK...POTEN

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY REGION
sections.text: MCS WILL LIKELY BE ONGOING FROM PORTIONS OF ERN KS INTO ERN OK 12Z WEDNESDAY. THE RICHER LOW LEVEL MOISTURE HAS BEEN SHUNTED INTO SRN AR BY A WEAK FRONTAL BOUNDARY...BUT AT LEAST LOW 60S DEWPOINTS WILL PERSIST ACROSS CNTRL/NRN AR WITH MID-UPPER 60S FARTHER SOUTH. THE ATMOSPHERE IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE ACROSS OVER CNTRL/SRN AR WITH MLCAPE FROM 1500-2500 J/KG DURING THE AFTERNOON. POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR STORMS TO REINTENSIFY ALONG THE CONVECTIVE PROGRESSIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WITH A THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL DURING THE DAY.

sections.title: NERN GULF COASTAL AREA
sections.text: LOW LEVEL SHEAR WILL INCREASE VERY LATE IN THE PERIOD ALONG THE NW FL COAST AHEAD OF THE NWD ADVANCING TROPICAL SYSTEM OVER THE ERN GULF OF MEXICO. A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT WITH CONVECTION SPREADING INLAND WITHIN A MOIST ENVIRONMENT. ..DIAL/COHEN.. 06/05/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AN UPPER LOW NOW LOCATED OVER THE ERN DAKOTAS/WRN MN WILL CONTINUE SHIFTING EWD INTO THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION WITH TIME -- WEAKENING SLIGHTLY AS IT PROGRESSES EWD. S OF THIS FEATURE...THE BROADER-SCALE TROUGH IS FORECAST TO EXPAND/AMPLIFY A BIT WITH TIME...AS SEVERAL SMALLER-SCALE CYCLONIC FEATURES -- BOTH CONVECTIVELY INDUCED AND OTHERWISE -- GRADUALLY BECOME A PART OF THE LARGER-SCALE CYCLONIC FLOW FIELD. MEANWHILE...RIDGING WILL PREVAIL OVER THE WRN U.S. THROUGH THE PERIOD. AT THE SURFACE...A WEAK COLD FRONT IS FORECAST TO CONTINUE MOVING SEWD ACROSS THE CENTRAL CONUS...WITH A FRONTAL LOW INVOF THE TX SOUTH PLAINS/PERMIAN BASIN REGION FORECAST TO AMPLIFY AS WEAK SHORT-WAVE TROUGHING CROSSES THE SRN ROCKIES. ELSEWHERE...A WEAK TROUGH EXTENDING NEWD FROM THE LOWER MS DELTA REGION NEWD INTO THE UPPER OH VALLEY SHOULD REMAIN GENERALLY IN PLACE...WHILE A WEAK LOW OVER THE CENTRAL GULF OF MEXICO DRIFTS SLOWLY NWD WITH TIME.

sections.title: SRN PLAINS
sections.text: WITH CLOUDS/PRECIPITATION ASSOCIATED WITH THE LARGE MCS CROSSING THE ERN KS/OK REGION ATTM LIKELY TO PERSIST ACROSS THE OK VICINITY THROUGH THIS MORNING...SEVERE POTENTIAL WILL LIKELY BE SHUNTED SWD ACROSS TOWARD THE RED RIVER VALLEY AND POINTS S. HERE...REMNANT OUTFLOW SHOULD EVENTUALLY MERGE WITH/REINFORCE A W-E WARM FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH THE WRN TX SURFACE LOW -- POSSIBLY PROVIDING A ZONE OF FOCUS FOR AFTERNOON/EVENING STRONG/SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT. GREATER THREAT FOR SEVERE WEATHER APPEARS TO EXIST FARTHER W HOWEVER...ACROSS THE TX SOUTH PLAINS REGION AND INTO ERN NM. HERE...ELY UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME SHOULD PROMOTE AFTERNOON/EVENING STORM DEVELOPMENT...AS A MODESTLY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER HEATS THROUGH THE AFTERNOON BENEATH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. THOUGH NOT EXCESSIVELY STRONG...MID-LEVEL WLYS ATOP THE LOW-LEVEL ELY FLOW WILL RESULT IN SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED/ROTATING STORMS -- AND THUS THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS REMAINS EVIDENT. WITH STORMS MOVING OUT OF ERN NM THIS EVENING POSSIBLY EVOLVING INTO AN MCS...A MORE FOCUSED CORRIDOR OF DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL INTO THE TX SOUTH PLAINS REGION ALSO REMAINS EVIDENT.

sections.title: AR INTO THE MID MS VALLEY REGION
sections.text: AN EWD EXPANSION OF SEVERE POTENTIAL IS BEING DEPICTED THIS FORECAST...AS THE LARGE MCS MOVING OUT OF ERN OK/KS THIS MORNING IS FORECAST TO CROSS SRN MO/AR INTO THIS AFTERNOON. AN ARC OF CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW AT THE LEADING EDGE OF THIS SYSTEM SHOULD ACT AS A FOCUS FOR INTENSIFICATION/RE-INITIATION OF STRONG-TO-SEVERE STORMS THIS AFTERNOON...AS DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION OF THE VERY MOIST AIRMASS ACROSS THIS REGION OCCURS. GIVEN THREATS FOR HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WHICH SHOULD INCREASE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AS THE SYSTEM PROGRESSES EWD...SLIGHT RISK IS BEING EXPANDED EWD ACROSS WRN TN/NRN MS.

sections.title: WRN FL COAST
sections.text: LOW-LEVEL ELY/SELY FLOW IS FORECAST TO STRENGTHEN A BIT ACROSS THE ERN GULF OF MEXICO DURING THE SECOND HALF OF THE PERIOD...IN CONJUNCTION WITH EXPECTATIONS THAT THE WEAK LOW OVER THE CENTRAL GULF DEVELOPS SLOWLY WHILE SHIFTING NWD/NNEWD. WITH SOME STRENGTHENING OF THE LOW-LEVEL FLOW AFFECTING THE WRN COAST OF FL -- PARTICULARLY DURING THE SECOND HALF OF THE PERIOD...A VERY LIMITED THREAT FOR A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO MAY EVOLVE WITHIN CONVECTION AROUND THE ERN/NERN FRINGE OF THE CYCLONIC CIRCULATION. ..GOSS/GARNER.. 06/05/2013

sections.title: NM
sections.text: MOIST POST-FRONTAL UPSLOPE FLOW AND DIFFERENTIAL HEATING WILL CONTRIBUTE TO STORM INITIATION OVER RATON PASS IN NERN NM WITH OTHER STORMS LIKELY DEVELOPING ON AND ACROSS THE HIGH TERRAIN THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. SURFACE HEATING DOWNSTREAM OF STORM INITIATION WILL BOOST SBCAPE TO OVER 1500 J/KG IN A BROAD CORRIDOR NORTH OF OUTFLOW REINFORCED COLD FRONT/COMPOSITE BOUNDARY THAT SHOULD BE SITUATED FROM ERN NM ACROSS WEST TX. DESPITE SOME INDICATION OF A WEAK SHORTWAVE TROUGH NEAR THE AZ/NM BORDER...LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT OVER THE REGION WILL LIKELY REMAIN SUBTLE. NONETHELESS...DIRECTIONAL/VERTICAL SHEAR IN THE STORM UPDRAFT LAYER IS FORECAST TO STRENGTHEN THROUGH THE EVENING AND REMAIN SUFFICIENT FOR UPDRAFT PERSISTENCE/ORGANIZATION WITH SOME HAIL AND WIND EVENTS POSSIBLE. ITS ALSO APPEARS POSSIBLE THAT ACTIVITY WILL EVENTUALLY CONGEAL INTO A SMALL MCS WHILE SPREADING EAST INTO WEST TX INTO THE EVENING. THIS SCENARIO WOULD RESULT IN A GREATER CHANCE OF DAMAGING WINDS FROM ERN NM ACROSS THE PORTIONS OF THE TX PNHDL AND INTO WEST TX/SOUTH PLAINS.

sections.title: WEST/SOUTHWEST TX
sections.text: AN AREA SEPARATE FROM THE MCS POTENTIAL ACROSS ERN NM WILL EXIST NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF THE COMPOSITE BOUNDARY AND DRYLINE ACROSS THE CONCHO VALLEY/SOUTHWEST TX. CONVECTION IS FORECAST TO INITIATE AS HEATING/MIXING OVERCOME INHIBITION EAST OF THE DRYLINE AND NEAR WEAK TRIPLE-POINT/THERMAL LOW. AIRMASS EAST OF THIS DEVELOPMENT IS FORECAST TO BECOME STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH FORECAST SOUNDINGS ALSO EXHIBITING DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER AND LARGE SUB-CLOUD TEMP/DEWPOINT SPREADS. LOW LEVEL FLOW WILL REMAIN GENERALLY WEAK AND TOPPED BY 20-30KT FLOW IN THE MID LEVELS RESULTING IN SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR A FEW STORMS TO PERSIST AND POSSIBLY PRODUCE LARGE HAIL. GIVEN POTENTIAL FOR DCAPE VALUES IN EXCESS OF 1000 J/KG...ANY CONVECTION WILL LIKELY BE ACCOMPANIED BY STRONG/DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: NORTH TX/OK/OZARKS EAST ACROSS MS VALLEY
sections.text: GREATER UNCERTAINTY IN CONVECTIVE REDEVELOPMENT AND STORM COVERAGE EXISTS AHEAD OF THE DECAYING MCS/MCV IN SRN MO AND EXTENSIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ARCING FROM NRN AR TO THE ARKLATEX AND THEN WWD INTO THE DFW AREA. IF STORMS CAN REGENERATE AMIDST A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS OVER ERN MO/AR THERE MAY BE A GREATER CONTRIBUTION SEVERE POTENTIAL EAST ACROSS THE MS RIVER INTO TN/MS AS EWD-TRACKING MCV AND ASSOCIATED COMPACT MID-LEVEL JET STREAK LEND SUPPORT TO BOTH ASCENT AND VERTICAL SHEAR ACROSS THESE AREAS. FARTHER SOUTH...CAPPING AND WEAKER FLOW ALOFT WILL LIKELY LIMIT SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL. LATEST VSBL SATL IMAGERY SHOWS CU DEVELOPING ALONG SYNOPTIC COLD FRONT SITUATED ACROSS NW OK. WHILE AIRMASS ACROSS MOST OF OK HAS BEEN STABILIZED/OVERTURNED BY AFOREMENTIONED MCS/OUTFLOW...STRONG HEATING OF ABUNDANTLY MOIST AIRMASS WILL LIKELY CONTRIBUTE TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF STRONG LATE AFTERNOON INSTABILITY AHEAD OF THE FRONT FROM SWRN TO SCNTRL OK. LIFT ALONG THE FRONT MAY BE AIDED BY SHORTWAVE TROUGH PIVOTING THROUGH THE BASE OF THE UPPER LOW/TROUGH ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS AROUND THE TIME OF MAXIMUM HEATING/DESTABILIZATION. THIS SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT TO OVERCOME CAPPING AND RESULT IN A FEW ROB

sections.title: TN VALLEY TO SRN APPALACHIANS SOUTHEAST
sections.text: REMNANT MCV/MCS WILL CONTINUE TO DRIFT EAST FROM THE TN VALLEY TOWARD SRN APPALACHIANS THROUGH TONIGHT. WHILE THERE WILL EXIST POCKETS OF STRONGER INSTABILITY AHEAD OF THIS FORCING THAT MAY OCCASIONALLY PROMOTE LOCALIZED STORM INTENSIFICATION...OVERALL WEAKNESS IN FLOW FIELDS/SHEAR AND LAPSE RATES SUGGEST THAT SEVERE WIND POTENTIAL WILL REMAIN ISOLATED BOTH TEMPORALLY AND SPATIALLY.

sections.title: FL
sections.text: LOW-LEVEL ELY/SELY FLOW IS FORECAST TO GRADUALLY STRENGTHEN OVER THE ERN GULF OF MEXICO THROUGH TONIGHT IN CONJUNCTION WITH DEVELOPING LOW MOVING NORTH FROM THE CENTRAL GULF. THIS STRENGTHENING OF THE LOW-LEVEL FLOW MAY IMPINGE UPON THE WRN/SRN COASTS OF FL WITH A LOW PROBABILITY TORNADO THREAT DEVELOPING IF CONVECTION INCREASES/INTENSIFIES IN THE ERN/NERN SEMI-CIRCLE WELL NORTH AND EAST OF THE GULF LOW. ..CARBIN/PETERS.. 06/05/2013

sections.title: NM/TX
sections.text: SVR TSTMS ACROSS ERN NM HAVE BEGUN TO MERGE/ORGANIZE ALONG A CONSOLIDATED COLD POOL AND WILL LIKELY MOVE E OR ESE OVERNIGHT AS A SVR MCS WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL. TORNADO THREAT WILL BE GREATEST WITH EMBEDDED MESOVORTICES AS THE COMPLEX MOVES ACROSS NW TX/FAR SRN OK ALONG FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM EARLY WED MORNING MCS. SVR TSTMS ACROSS THE PERMIAN BASIN/CONCHO VALLEY IN THE VICINITY OF SFC TROUGH WILL REMAIN CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL...POSSIBLY SIGNIFICANT...AND DAMAGING WINDS GIVEN DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER. THESE TSTMS MAY EVENTUALLY MERGE WITH COMPLEX MOVING EWD FROM NM LATER TONIGHT.

sections.title: PORTIONS OF THE MID/LOWER MS VALLEY REGION
sections.text: SVR TSTMS OVER MID MS VALLEY ASSOCIATED WITH MCV OVER ERN MO/WRN IL WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A RISK FOR SVR HAIL/WIND IN AN ENVIRONMENT WITH 35-40 KTS OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AND MODERATE INSTABILITY. THE SVR POTENTIAL SHOULD DIMINISH LATER THIS EVENING WITH THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING.

sections.title: FL
sections.text: REF MCD 972 ISSUED AT 0048Z FOR THE LATEST SHORT-TERM THINKING REGARDING THE TORNADO THREAT ASSOCIATED WITH TROPICAL STORM ANDREA. ..BUNTING.. 06/06/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT IS LIKELY TO DEVELOP OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS ACROSS ERN AR...NRN-CNTRL MS AND NRN-CNTRL AL. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE WILL BE POSSIBLE ACROSS THE REGION THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A BROAD WARM SECTOR LOCATED FROM THE ARKLATEX EXTENDING EWD INTO THE TN VALLEY WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE LOWER TO MID 70S F AND MLCAPE VALUES ARE LIKELY IN THE 1500 TO 2500 J/KG RANGE. LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE IS MAXIMIZED ALONG AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY LOCATED IN NRN MS WHERE CELLS ARE INCREASING IN COVERAGE. ANOTHER OUTFLOW BOUNDARY IS MOVING EWD ACROSS AR AND THIS FEATURE SHOULD ALSO BE A FOCUS FOR CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT AS IT NEARS THE MS RIVER THIS AFTERNOON. AS SFC TEMPS CONTINUE TO WARM THROUGH THE MID TO UPPER 80S F ACROSS MUCH OF THE MCD AREA...LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL STEEPEN CREATING CONDITIONS FAVORABLE FOR DAMAGING OUTFLOW GUSTS. IN ADDITION...AS INSTABILITY CONTINUES TO INCREASE THIS AFTERNOON...HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH THE MORE INTENSE CORES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT SHOULD DEVELOP ACROSS NE NM AND MAY AFFECT THE WRN TX PANHANDLE LATER THIS AFTERNOON. LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE WILL BE POSSIBLE AS CELLS INCREASE IN COVERAGE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. WW ISSUANCE MAY BECOME NECESSARY ACROSS THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A LEE TROUGH WITH ELY UPSLOPE FLOW IN PLACE ACROSS MUCH OF ERN NM. TERRAIN EFFECTS ARE LIKELY CAUSING THE FLOW TO VEER TO SLY IN THE RATON AREA WHERE CELLS ARE DEVELOPING IN THE HIGHER TERRAIN. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SUGGESTS THAT MLCAPE VALUES IN NE NM ARE IN THE 1000 TO 1500 J/KG RANGE WHERE 0-6 KM SHEAR IS ESTIMATED AT 30 TO 40 KT. THIS ENVIRONMENT MAY SUPPORT SUPERCELLS ESPECIALLY AS THE STORMS MOVE EWD INTO THE LOWER ELEVATIONS WHERE LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IS GREATER AND SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE MID 50S F. AS INSTABILITY INCREASES AND MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES STEEPEN MORE...THE STRONGER CORES SHOULD HAVE AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL THREAT. ALSO...LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ALREADY EXCEED 8.0 C/KM ACROSS MUCH OF NE NM WHICH SHOULD ENHANCE DOWNDRAFT SPEEDS MAKING WIND DAMAGE POSSIBLE AS THE CELLS MATURE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT APPEARS LIKELY TO DEVELOP LATE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS PARTS OF SW AND WCNTRL TX. LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE MAY BECOME NECESSARY ACROSS PARTS OF THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A 1004 MB LOW OVER WEST TX WHERE TEMPS HAVE WARMED TO ABOVE 100 F. THUNDERSTORMS ARE CURRENTLY INCREASING IN COVERAGE SOUTH OF THE SFC LOW ON THE WRN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS ESTIMATES THAT MLCAPE VALUES ACROSS SW AND WCNTRL TX ARE IN THE 1000 TO 2000 J/KG RANGE. SHORT-TERM MODEL FORECASTS SUGGEST THAT THE STORMS IN WEST TX WILL MOVE EWD AND EXPAND IN COVERAGE WITH ADDITIONAL STORMS INITIATING NEAR SAN ANGELO AROUND 22Z. THE INSTABILITY COMBINED WITH 30 TO 40 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR SHOULD SUPPORT STORM ORGANIZATION AND SUPERCELLS WILL BE POSSIBLE. THE MODERATE INSTABILITY AND STEEP LAPSE RATES SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR LARGE HAIL. WIND DAMAGE WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE ESPECIALLY DUE TO THE VERY WARM BOUNDARY LAYER TEMPS AND LARGE TEMP-DEWPOINT SPREADS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS MAY BE INCREASING ACROSS MAINLY CENTRAL MS THROUGH THE LATE AFTERNOON...WITHIN WW 279.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 2045Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED TSTMS CONTINUING ACROSS FAR NERN LA THROUGH CENTRAL MS TO PARTS OF NRN AL. THE ENVIRONMENT ALONG AND SOUTH OF THIS ACTIVITY REMAINS MODERATELY-STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE OF 2000-3000 J/KG. BULK SHEAR HAS BEEN RELATIVELY WEAK LIMITING STORM ORGANIZATION. HOWEVER...AN INCREASE IN WLY MIDLEVEL WINDS /50 KT IN THE 4-6 KM AGL LAYER AT LZK SINCE ABOUT 1930Z/ SPREADING EWD COULD SUPPORT A GREATER DAMAGING WIND THREAT...ESPECIALLY WITH ANY MORE N-S ORIENTED LINE SEGMENTS. THIS DAMAGING WIND THREAT MAY BE ENHANCED BY FURTHER COLD POOL DEVELOPMENT AND GIVEN THE STRENGTH OF DOWNSTREAM DCAPE /UP TO 1200 J PER KG/ PER OBJECTIVE ANALYSES IN CENTRAL MS. ..PETERS.. 06/05/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STORMS MAY PRODUCE GUSTY WINDS THROUGH EARLY EVENING...BUT A WW IS NOT NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS HAVE BECOME LOOSELY ORGANIZED INTO NNE/SSW-ORIENTED CONVECTIVE SEGMENTS OVER PARTS OF THE CNTRL/SRN APPALACHIANS...AS OROGRAPHIC EFFECTS HAVE BOOSTED ASCENT AT THE LEADING EDGE OF A DISORGANIZED CONVECTIVE COMPLEX THAT EARLIER CROSSED PARTS OF THE TN VALLEY. DIURNAL DIABATIC HEATING HAS CONTRIBUTED TO ONLY MARGINAL DESTABILIZATION N OF AN ILL-DEFINED STATIONARY FRONT OVER THE COASTAL PLAIN/PIEDMONT REGION OF SC AND GA. MLCAPE VALUES ONLY REACH AROUND 500-800 J/KG N OF THIS BOUNDARY PER MODIFIED 12Z RAOBS...WITH MORE SUBSTANTIAL MOISTENING/BUOYANCY RELEGATED TO LOCATIONS FARTHER S. REGARDLESS...ENOUGH INSTABILITY EXISTS DOWNSTREAM/E OF THE AFOREMENTIONED ACTIVITY FOR ITS SUSTENANCE UNTIL AROUND DUSK. THEREAFTER...NOCTURNAL COOLING OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO A WEAKENING TREND OF ONGOING ACTIVITY. UNTIL THEN...A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY OCCUR...THOUGH THE WEAK INSTABILITY...AND ONLY AROUND 15 KT OF 0-6-KM BULK SHEAR SAMPLED BY MRX VWP...SUGGEST THAT THE SVR POTENTIAL WILL BE VERY LOW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR A FEW STORMS WITH STRONG TO LOCALLY SVR DOWNBURST WINDS CONTINUES ACROSS REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF WW 279...AND THE WW HAS BEEN EXPANDED SWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF CNTRL/SRN MS UPON COORDINATION WITH THE JACKSON MS WEATHER FORECAST OFFICE. THE WW MAY BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE ON SCHEDULE AT 00Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE AMALGAMATION OF CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS ACROSS PORTIONS OF CNTRL/SRN MS HAS GIVEN WAY TO A NE/SW-ORIENTED SQUALL LINE THAT EXTENDS FROM KEMPER COUNTY TO JUST S OF METRO JACKSON TO FRANKLIN COUNTY MS. RECENT RADAR TRENDS SUGGEST THAT THIS ACTIVITY ALONG AND N OF THE INTERSTATE 20 CORRIDOR IS BECOMING ANAFRONTAL AS OUTFLOW SURGES AHEAD OF PARENT CONVECTION. HOWEVER...SMALL HAIL/GUSTY WINDS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH THIS ACTIVITY. MEANWHILE...THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY MAY BOOST CONVECTIVE INTENSITY FARTHER S WHERE CONVECTION IS STILL IN THE MATURATION PROCESS. ADDITIONALLY...AGGREGATE NWD-ADVANCING SEA BREEZE CONVERGENCE ZONES/CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES MAY LOCALLY ENHANCE CONVECTION WHERE OVERTURNING HAS NOT ALREADY OCCURRED BETWEEN INTERSTATE 20 AND HIGHWAY 84. AROUND 2000-3000 J/KG OF MLCAPE EXISTS IN THESE AREAS PER MODIFIED 12Z JAN RAOB. ONLY MODEST DEEP SHEAR PER JAN VWP SHOULD LARGELY LIMIT CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION OUTSIDE OF THE SQUALL LINE. HOWEVER...DCAPE AROUND 1000 J/KG WHERE CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING HAS NOT OCCURRED WILL AUGMENT PRECIPITATION LOADING PROCESSES IN YIELDING STRONG DOWNDRAFTS WITH A LOCALIZED DMGG WIND THREAT. BY 00Z...CONVECTION SHOULD BE WEAKENING AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER COOLS YIELDING NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION. ..COHEN.. 06/05/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STORMS MAY BECOME SVR WITH LARGE HAIL DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. HOWEVER...THE ISOLATED...SHORT-DURATION NATURE OF SUCH THREAT WILL LIKELY PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION IS DEVELOPING INVOF AN E/W-ORIENTED WEAK STATIONARY SFC FRONT FROM A TRIPLE POINT 15 SSE FLP TO 30 S JBR. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY ALSO INDICATES TCU DEVELOPMENT ALONG AN E/W-ORIENTED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY STRETCHING ACROSS CNTRL AR THAT ALSO ARCS NEWD TO JUST W OF MEM. INFLOW SUPPORTING DEVELOPING CONVECTION IS CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATE INSTABILITY -- I.E. AROUND 1000-2000 J/KG OF MLCAPE AS DIURNAL HEATING OCCURRED AMIDST UPPER 60S/LOWER 70S SFC DEWPOINTS. DEEP SHEAR IN THE SRN PERIPHERY OF A MID-LEVEL SHORTWAVE IMPULSE CROSSING THE MID MS VALLEY WILL ALLOW SOME OF THESE STORMS TO BECOME ORGANIZED...WITH MARGINAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES POTENTIALLY SUPPORTING LARGE HAIL ON AN ISOLATED BASIS. HOWEVER...WITH NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION TO COMMENCE SHORTLY...AND GIVEN THE ONLY GLANCING NATURE OF THE SHORTWAVE IMPULSE...STORMS SHOULD QUICKLY WEAKEN AFTER SUNSET.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT OF SEVERE HAIL AND WIND PERSISTS FROM E CNTRL NM INTO W TX...WITH THE GREATEST THREAT FROM TCC TO CVS TO LBB NEXT FEW HOURS. OTHER STORMS MAY AFFECT SERN PORTIONS OF THE WATCH LATER THIS EVENING WITH HAIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF SEVERE STORMS WITH WIND AND HAIL CONTINUES TO DEVELOP SSEWD ACROSS E CNTRL NM IN A WEAK LOW PRESSURE TROUGH. TO THE E...COOLER AIR EXISTS BEHIND A COLD FRONT WHICH WAS SITUATED S OF AMA AND N OF PVW AT 00Z. THIS FRONT SHOULD GENERALLY DELINEATE THE NRN BOUNDS OF THE SEVERE THREAT AS STORMS DEVELOP SEWD ALONG IT. ALTHOUGH SOME BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING WILL OCCUR SOON...INCREASING ELY LOW LEVEL FLOW MAY ENHANCE FORWARD PROPAGATION POTENTIAL OF THESE STORMS...ALSO SUPPORTED BY FAVORABLE DEEP LAYER SHEAR. THE ELY WINDS WILL ALSO MAINTAIN 60S F DEWPOINTS ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE S PLAINS WHICH WILL MAINTAIN SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY. THE STRONGEST STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE SSEWD ACROSS QUAY AND INTO CURRY COUNTY NM...AND EVENTUALLY MAY TURN EWD A BIT ACROSS DEAF SMITH AND PARMER COUNTIES IN THE SHORT TERM. WIND DRIVEN HAIL IS LIKELY. ..JEWELL.. 06/05/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR A BRIEF/WEAK TORNADO WILL EXIST THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS AS THE OUTER CIRCULATION OF TROPICAL STORM ANDREA AFFECTS PARTS OF FLORIDA. WHILE CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED...THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS UNLIKELY. PLEASE SEE THE LATEST ADVISORIES FROM THE NATIONAL HURRICANE CENTER FOR FURTHER INFORMATION ON ANDREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THREE AREAS OF CONVECTION WITH A LOW-END TORNADO THREAT WILL EXIST THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS: /1/ LOW-TOPPED CONVECTION -- INCLUDING WEAK SUPERCELLS -- LIES NEAR/N OF A WNW/ESE-ORIENTED SFC CONFLUENCE AXIS ANALYZED FROM THE GULF COAST OVER NRN PARTS OF MAINLAND MONROE COUNTY INTO SRN PARTS OF THE MIAMI AREA ALONG THE ATLANTIC COAST. ADDITIONAL CONVECTION ARCS NWD INTO SRN BROWARD COUNTY ALONG AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT SURGED WWD FROM EARLIER CONVECTION THAT COLLAPSED OFF THE ATLANTIC COAST. THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY INTERSECTS THE CONFLUENCE AXIS IN CNTRL MIAMI-DADE COUNTY...AND THIS INTERSECTION POINT -- MOVING GENERALLY WWD -- MAY FOCUS ENHANCED CONVERGENCE AND CONVECTION DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. AREAS ELSEWHERE ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND CONFLUENCE AXIS WILL SERVE AS FOCI FOR CONVECTION. /2/ CLUSTERS OF MORE VIGOROUS STORMS INCLUDING EMBEDDED SUPERCELL STRUCTURES ARE ADVANCING GENERALLY NWD OFF THE COAST OF LEE AND CHARLOTTE COUNTIES...AND THIS ACTIVITY COULD GLANCE COASTAL AREAS AS FAR NORTH AS MANATEE COUNTY DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. /3/ DEVELOPING CONVECTION WILL MOVE NWD FROM THE STRAITS OF FL...IMPACTING THE FL KEYS DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS...ESPECIALLY THE LOWER KEYS. REGARDING THE TORNADO POTENTIAL ACROSS ALL OF THESE AREAS...LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IS BOLSTERED BY A VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE IN THE LOWEST 3 KM AGL. VWP DATA FROM MIAMI...TAMPA BAY/RUSKIN...AND KEY WEST ALL INDICATE AROUND 50-150 M2/S2 OF 0-1-KM SRH AFTER ACCOUNTING FOR OBSERVED STORM MOTIONS. THE GREATEST LOW-LEVEL SHEAR AND 0-1-KM SRH IS CONCENTRATED OVER THE W FL COAST AND OVER THE LOWER FL KEYS -- I.E. IN CLOSER PROXIMITY TO THE STRONGER LOW-LEVEL FLOW ACCOMPANYING TROPICAL STORM ANDREA. AND...WITH KEY WEST AND MIAMI 00Z RAOB DATA INDICATING MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE AROUND 1500 J/KG

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN INTENSE MCS WILL CONTINUE TO PRODUCE EXTREMELY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL FROM THE S PLAINS INTO NWRN TX.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WIDESPREAD SIGNIFICANT DAMAGING WINDS HAVE BEEN MEASURED ACROSS W TX WITH AN MCS THAT CONTINUES TO MOVE EWD. IN ADDITION TO DAMAGING WINDS AND WIND-DRIVEN HAIL WITH THE PRIMARY LEADING BOW...PROLONGED DAMAGING REAR-INFLOW AND WAKE WINDS PERSIST IN EXCESS OF 75 MPH. THIS SYSTEM IS EXPECTED TO MAINTAIN INTENSITY FOR A COUPLE MORE HOURS BEFORE POTENTIALLY INTERACTING WITH A CONVECTIVE COMPLEX THAT IS MOVING NEWD ACROSS THE ABILENE AREA WITH HAIL AND WIND. ..JEWELL.. 06/06/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR ISOLATED BRIEF TORNADOES IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST THROUGH THE EARLY MORNING HOURS. TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS MORNING TROPICAL STORM ANDREA WAS CENTERED OVER THE NERN GULF OF MEXICO AND MOVING GENERALLY NWD /SEE LATEST DISCUSSIONS FROM NHC FOR DETAILS/. THE OUTER RAINBANDS ATTENDING ANDREA ARE LIFTING NWD THROUGH SRN AND WCNTRL FL...GENERALLY ALONG AND SOUTH OF A LINE FROM TAMPA SEWD TO NEAR PALM BEACH. A BELT OF STRONGER WINDS EAST OF THE CENTER IS CONTRIBUTING TO RATHER SIZEABLE HODOGRAPHS. THE TAMPA BAY VWP INDICATE BACKED SELY NEAR SFC WINDS VEERING TO SLY ABOVE 3 KM WITH LARGE 0-1 KM HODOGRAPHS SUPPORTING 0-1 KM STORM RELATIVE HELICITY AROUND 300 M2/S2. AS USUAL WITH THESE SYSTEMS...THE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT IS CHARACTERIZED BY WEAK BUOYANCY AND MOIST ADIABATIC PROFILES WHICH COULD POTENTIALLY SERVE AS A LIMITING FACTOR GIVEN TIME OF DAY. NEVERTHELESS...OCCASIONAL MINI-SUPERCELL STRUCTURES CONTINUE TO BE OBSERVED ON RADAR...AND THE THREAT FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES WILL LIKELY PERSIST THROUGH THE EARLY MORNING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT HAS BECOME MARGINAL ACROSS REMAINING PARTS OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 281. A LIMITED THREAT FOR ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL MIGHT PERSIST ANOTHER HOUR OR TWO...MAINLY EAST OF WW FROM NCNTRL TX TO EXTREME SRN OK. REMAINING PORTIONS OF THE WW CAN BE CANCELLED...AND ANOTHER WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS REMAIN ACTIVE ALONG NRN PORTION OF A LARGE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT EXTENDS FROM EXTREME SWRN OK THROUGH NCNTRL TX THEN SWWD TO NEAR SANDERSON IN SWRN TX. TRENDS HAVE BEEN FOR STORMS TO DECREASE IN ORGANIZATION AND INTENSITY AS OUTFLOW BOUNDARY MOVED INTO A LESS FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT WHERE SHEAR IS WEAK AND SBCAPE HAS BECOME MARGINAL. ADDITIONAL ROBUST STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG SWRN EXTENT OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY APPEARS UNLIKELY DUE TO STRONG SFC BASED CONVECTIVE INHIBITION...AND LIKELIHOOD THAT FORCING FOR ASCENT ALONG THIS PORTION OF THE BOUNDARY IS MORE SHALLOW. ..DIAL.. 06/06/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST THREAT FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES WILL REMAIN ACROSS THE ERN PORTION OF THE CNTRL AND SRN FL PENINSULA THROUGH 13Z. THERE APPEARS TO BE AT LEAST A TEMPORARY LULL IN THE SEVERE THREAT OVER MUCH OF THE WRN HALF OF WW 282.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BAND OF LOW TOPPED SUPERCELLS ALONG ONE OF THE OUTER BANDS OF TROPICAL STORM ANDREA HAS SHIFTED INTO THE ERN THIRD OF THE FL PENINSULA. WHAT APPEARS TO BE A MID-LEVEL MESOSCALE CIRCULATION IS EMBEDDED WITHIN THE NRN END OF THIS BAND. LARGE HODOGRAPHS CONTINUE TO BE OBSERVED WITH VWP DATA ALONG AND AHEAD OF THIS BROKEN LINE OF CONVECTION. ISOLATED TORNADOES WILL REMAIN A POSSIBILITY AS THIS ACTIVITY CONTINUES EWD AND EVENTUALLY OFFSHORE. TAMPA BAY VWP INDICATE HODOGRAPHS ARE STILL FAVORABLE FOR LOW-LEVEL MESOCYCLONES. HOWEVER...SUBSIDENCE APPEARS TO BE OCCURRING OVER THE WRN HALF OF THE CNTRL AND SRN FL PENINSULA IN WAKE OF INITIAL LINE OF STORMS. DEEPER CONVECTION MIGHT REMAIN SUPPRESSED OVER A LARGE PART OF THE WRN TWO THIRDS OF THE PENINSULA UNTIL SECONDARY BAND OVER THE ERN GULF APPROACHES THE WRN FL COAST AROUND 14-15Z. ..DIAL.. 06/06/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
